text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: My legs have felt so heavy lately. It's like I'm running all alone in deep mud...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
choice_data_list: I want to see Suzuka run like only she can again.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
I'm... not alone anymore, after all.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
...And, um. I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You're right. If I can't run my own race,
winning is just...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. In the next race, without fail,
I will show you my true running.
